newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine leader to meet Pope in Poland on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine leader to meet Pope in Poland on Tuesday.

text.p: Ukrainian President Leonid Kuchma will fly to the Polish city of Gniezno on Tuesday to meet Pope John Paul II, a source in the presidential administration said on Saturday.

The visit has not been officially announced but another source in the foreign ministry also confirmed it. The 77-year-old, Polish-born Pope started an 11-day visit to 12 cities of Poland earlier on Saturday.

Kuchma, whose country has a five-million-strong Greek Catholic community, met the Pope in the Vatican in 1995 but stopped short of inviting him to Ukraine, where tensions exist between Catholics and Orthodox faithful.
